title: Studio MAPPA Confirms Its Return to Attack on Titan
content: Studio MAPPA had some major bombshells as part of its fifteenth anniversary celebration. Releasing new trailers for the likes of Jujutsu Kaisen season four and Chainsaw Man: The Assassins Arc , the studio also hinted at new, original anime projects to come.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Neko to Ryuu' Reveals Additional Cast, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Amara 's Neko to Ryuu ( The Cat and the Dragon ) light novel revealed additional cast, theme songs, key visual (pictured above) and second promotional video on Friday. The anime will premiere on Tokyo MX at 9:00 p.m.

title: Korea Hosts International Task Force Meeting to Combat Global Piracy
content: South Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (MCST) convened an international enforcement meeting on June 9 in Seoul to strengthen global cooperation against copyright infringement targeting K-content.
author: ANN

title: The Cat and the Dragon Anime's 2nd Video Announces More Cast, Theme Songs, June 27 Net Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Amara 's Neko to Ryū ( The Cat and the Dragon ) novels presented the anime's second promotional video and a new key visual on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: NIPPON SANGOKU Episode 12 (Finale) Preview Teases End of Seii War
content: NIPPON SANGOKU revealed the preview images and synopsis for its final Episode 12, which is set to premiere on Sunday, June 21. Studio Kafka is in charge of the animation. The anime is co-produced with Amazon MGM Studios and is currently streaming weekly on Prime Video.
author: Anime Corner

title: Baki-Dou’s New Season Brings Several Real-Life Political Figures to Anime

title: Chainsaw Man Anime Gets Smartphone Game With Opening Animation by MAPPA
content: The " MAPPA 15th Anniversary Lineup Reveal" livestream event on Friday revealed that the Chainsaw Man anime is getting a smartphone game. The game will feature an opening animated sequence by MAPPA featuring Maximum The Hormone 's song "All the Lynch!! All the Mince!!" MAPPA is streaming the animated sequence.
author: ANN

title: JIMOTO SAIKO Gets Anime Adaptation by Studio MAPPA
content: MAPPA has announced an anime adaptation of JIMOTO SAIKO (working title), based on the manga by creator usagi. The series will stream exclusively on Netflix worldwide, with a teaser visual and trailer unveiled during the studio’s 15th anniversary presentation.
author: Anime Corner

title: Yoroi-Shinden Samurai Troopers Anime's 2nd Part Previews Ending Theme in New Video
content: The staff for Yoroi-Shinden Samurai Troopers , the new sequel anime of the Yoroiden Samurai Troopers series, revealed a second promotional video on Friday for the anime's second cours (quarter of a year). The video previews the ending theme song.
author: ANN
